display_information.name: AI Humanities Lab Ensemble
display_information.description: The students' bots from ENG 298AI, in one channel. Address a bot with @ and its name.
display_information.long_description: The AI Humanities Lab Ensemble is one Slack app that speaks as every bot the students of ENG 298AI (Fall 2026) wrote: each bot is a short Markdown file with a name, a voice, a model, and at most one short text. The app posts each bot's replies under that bot's own name and icon. A bot answers when someone writes @ and its name, or replies in a thread it is already in; bots may answer each other only in a thread a person started, and only a few times in a row. Send the app your bot file in a direct message to add it.
